identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

precedence: v2 common definitions replace v1 common and exact listed module pointers only after Owner adoption. Original embedded behavior rows are historical trace, not competing runtime protocol. Context means WorkflowContext, operation_id means TransitionKey.operation_id at every material call. No in-place update to original Approved artifacts.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

material_api.import: import(WorkflowContext,TrustedSourceSelection,ImportMetadata,TransitionKey)->ImportedPinnedManifest; native source bytes verified before durable immutable import; no UI path authority
material_api.register_roots: register_roots(TrustedProviderCapability,RootKind)->RootRegistration; internal trusted composition only; no UI registration/callback
material_api.publish_roots: publish_roots(RootRegistration,expected_epoch:u64,RootManifest,TransitionKey)->RootObservationReceipt; owner provider attests current fenced manifest; stale epoch => StaleRoots, unknown => Unknown not empty

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {WorkflowContext,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; same immutable workflow across pin/transfer; no transition operation_id in context.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer receipt lookup with issuer/kind/WorkflowContext/target/evidence validation per proof_registry_record; no trusted DTO body. Missing runtime-only issuer record => UnverifiedOutcome.
proof_types.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

recovery_readiness.LocalIntegrityReady: Native coherent recovery index+payload+ALL material copies and hashes/schema verified; independent from original catalog availability.
recovery_readiness.PublicationAcknowledged: Original M05 root transfer receipt and original captured S1 Published/ACK verified.
recovery_readiness.restore: LocalIntegrityReady permits explicit restore to authorized destination even SourceRetentionDeferred. Destination import+durable pin+M04 new-unsaved install mandatory; original Held/Unknown retained and no fake original Published/ACK. Missing/corrupt local blob always blocks.

reservation_kinds.FormalWriteReservation: blocks same-owner content edits until matching IO completion; read diagnostics allowed.
reservation_kinds.RecoveryAttemptReservation: one recovery attempt; after immutable capture+pin, live healthy owner may edit. Never reuse formal saving state for whole recovery copy pipeline.
reservation_kinds.CatalogLease: short transition only, no callbacks into document owner while held.

native Windows11 alias/8.3/reparse/durability separately measured; environment NOT RUN remains

Per-command exact DTO/schema and phase fixtures compiled independently before valid RED

U64Decimal.semantic_validation: parse checked u64 <=18446744073709551615; reject JSON number; never JS Number conversion

wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

proof_registry_record.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

proof_registry_record.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

store_read_contract.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.
store_read_contract.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

mutation_wire_result.precommit_error: {ok:false,error:closed existing error}; zero content commit. Once S1 commit occurred cannot use ErrorUnchanged, undo rollback or failed toast implying no effect.
mutation_wire_result.ui: Show installed revision plus material retention pending; preserve Held, disable unsafe pin release/export until proofs complete. Replay returns original result, never reapply or overwrite newer projection. Writer transfer has separate BindingProjection result, never fabricate mutation/history.
